description: Get one Atlas obligation record by its ID (e.g. OBL-AU-CPS230-47), with tier basis, key dates, source link, last-verified date and provenance reference. Coverage: the Atlas holds records for Australia, Singapore and international standards. When a response carries a coverage note for a jurisdiction, tell the user that the Atlas does not yet cover it; never read an empty result as meaning no obligations apply. Records with appliesToAnyAIUse apply to any AI use rather than to particular use cases. Responses are records, not legal conclusions. When you quote a record, cite its source link, tier and last-verified date (the citeAs field does this). Describe tiers as describing sources: never tell the user that they or a client are compliant, in breach, or required to do something; say what the source says and that counsel decides what applies. For Anticipated records give the status or key date, never a likelihood that the source will pass or apply. Records state what sources say and how they are classified. They are not legal advice and do not say what the law requires of any particular client; counsel decides what applies.
name: get_obligation
title: Get one obligation
